paragraphs: We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software solutions. Our more than 60-year history of innovation dates back to our diverse origins from AT&T/Bell Labs, Lucent and Hewlett-Packard Company, and has evolved through acquisitions, including LSI Corporation, Broadcom Corporation, Brocade Communications Systems, Inc., CA, Inc., Symantec Enterprise Security, and VMware, Inc. ("VMware"). Over the years, we have assembled a large team of semiconductor and software design engineers around the world. We maintain design, product and software development engineering expertise and resources at locations primarily in the U.S., Asia, and Europe. We combine global scale, engineering depth, broad product portfolio, superior execution and operational focus to deliver category-leading semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions.

Our strategy is focused on sustained technology leadership and developing category-leading solutions to deliver a comprehensive suite of innovative infrastructure technology products to the world's leading business and government customers. We seek to achieve this through extensive internal research and development, as well as strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies, to ensure our products retain their technology market leadership. This strategy results in a robust business model designed to drive diversified and sustainable operating and financial results.

Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions include a broad portfolio of complex digital and mixed signal devices based on silicon wafers with complementary metal oxide semiconductor ("CMOS") transistors, III-V based devices, network interface cards ("NICs") and other modules, switches, subsystems and, in some cases, racks. Our solutions are used in a wide array of environments, end products and applications, such as enterprise and artificial intelligence ("AI") data centers, servers and networking and connectivity equipment, as well as storage systems, home connectivity devices, set-top boxes ("STB"), broadband access, telecommunication equipment, wireless devices and base stations, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy systems, and electronic displays. We differentiate ourselves through our high-performance design and integration capabilities, and focus on developing semiconductor products for markets that require our high quality, leading technology and integrated performance semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions.

Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions also enable our customers to build and deploy AI data center infrastructure for their training and inference workloads and manage the movement of data across their AI network infrastructure based on open, flexible, standards-based Ethernet. In addition, our solutions enable accelerated compute and networking connectivity at scale, within and across AI server racks and across AI data center sites. Customers of these solutions are hyperscalers and companies with AI frontier models, as well as original equipment manufacturers ("OEMs") and system integrators that develop servers, switches and racks deployed in large-scale AI data centers to run training and inference workloads. Our AI semiconductor solutions include custom accelerators or XPUs, Ethernet switching and routing silicon, Ethernet NICs, physical layer devices ("PHYs") and optical components, as well as racks and systems based on our XPUs.

We offer our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions in five major end markets: Networking Connectivity, Wireless Device Connectivity, Servers and Storage Systems, Broadband and Industrial. Below is a description of our key solutions by end market and application.

Networking Connectivity. Our solutions manage the movement of data in data center, service provider and enterprise networking applications. We develop semiconductor products that enable accelerated compute and networking connectivity deployed in enterprise and AI data centers and service providers for their workloads. Our products offer an open, flexible, standards-based Ethernet NIC and switching solution to resolve connectivity bottlenecks in data centers, particularly in AI data centers where compute bandwidth and cluster sizes grow rapidly. The following products can be used for both AI and non-AI workloads and applications.

•Custom Silicon Solutions: We provide advanced technology and intellectual property ("IP") platforms for customers to design and develop application specific integrated circuits ("ASICs") for AI and high-performance computing, networking and storage applications. Our custom silicon solutions provide the platform to integrate embedded logic, high-bandwidth memory, serializer/deserializer technology, IP cores and processor cores using advanced packaging technologies. ASICs are custom products built to our individual customers' specifications, such as our custom accelerators or XPUs, for hyperscalers, companies with AI frontier models and system integrators, and in some cases used in racks or systems.

•Ethernet Switching & Routing: Ethernet is a ubiquitous interconnection technology that enables high-performance and cost-effective networking infrastructure. We offer a broad set of Ethernet switching and routing products that are optimized for enterprise and AI data center, service provider and enterprise networks. For our hyperscaler and other customers with AI frontier models, our high capacity, low-latency, switching silicon supports advanced protocols around virtualization and multi-pathing for data centers. Our Ethernet switching fabric technologies provide the ability to build highly scalable flat networks supporting tens of thousands of servers. Our service provider switch portfolio enables carrier networks to support prioritized delivery of data traffic in the wireless backhaul, access, aggregation and core of their networks. For enterprise networks, we offer product families with secure, encrypted switching capabilities and support lower power modes that comply with industry standards around energy efficient Ethernet.
•Ethernet NIC Controllers: Our Ethernet NIC controllers are designed for high-performance virtualization, intelligent flow processing, secure data center connectivity and machine learning.

•Physical Layer Devices: These devices are transceivers that enable the reception and transmission of Ethernet data packets over a physical medium such as copper wire or optical fibers. Our high-performance Ethernet transceivers are built upon a proprietary digital signal processing (DSP) communication architecture optimized for high-speed network connections and support the latest standards and advanced features, such as energy efficient Ethernet, data encryption and time synchronization. We also offer a range of automotive Ethernet products, including PHYs, switches and camera microcontrollers for in-vehicle connectivity and smart vision.

•Fiber Optic Components: We supply a wide array of optical components for the Ethernet networking, storage, and access, metro- and long-haul telecommunication markets. Our optical components enable the high-speed reception and transmission of data through optical fibers.

Wireless Device Connectivity Solutions. We provide leading edge connectivity solutions for the wireless device market. Our products include radio frequency ("RF") front-end modules and filters, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth combination chips, custom touch controllers and inductive charging devices.

•RF Semiconductor Devices: Our devices selectively filter, as well as amplify and route, RF signals. Filters enable modern wireless communication systems to support a large number of subscribers simultaneously by ensuring that the multiple transmissions and receptions of voice and data streams do not interfere with each other. Our RF devices include multi-chip front-end modules that integrate transmit/receive switching and filtering functions for multiple frequency bands, filter modules and discrete filters, all using our proprietary commercial film bulk acoustic resonator ("FBAR") filter technology. Our expertise in FBAR technology, amplifier design, and module integration enables us to offer industry-leading performance in cellular RF transceiver applications.

•Connectivity Solutions: Our solutions are designed for use in wireless devices including smartphones, tablets and wearable products. We offer a family of high performance, low power Wi-Fi chipsets, as well as Bluetooth silicon and software products. These solutions include combination chips that offer integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth functionality, which provides significant performance advantages over discrete solutions.

headings: Risks Related to Owning Our Common Stock
Adverse global economic conditions could have a negative effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition and liquidity.
Global political and economic conditions and other factors related to our international operations could adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We operate in a highly cyclical semiconductor industry that is undergoing profound change due to AI.
A significant reduction in demand from certain customers or loss of one or more of our significant customers may adversely affect our business.
Failure to adjust our manufacturing and supply chain to meet customer demand could adversely affect our results of operations.
We purchase a significant amount of the materials, including components, used in our products from a limited number of suppliers.
Our business would be adversely affected by the departure of existing members of our senior management team.
Our gross margin is dependent on a number of factors, including our product mix, adoption of a new business model, price erosion, level of capacity utilization and commodity prices.
If we are unable to attract and retain qualified personnel, especially our engineering and technical personnel, we may not be able to execute our business strategy effectively.

A prolonged disruption of our or our customers' or suppliers' facilities or other significant operations could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
We are subject to risks associated with our distributors and other channel partners, including product inventory levels and product sell-through.
Failure of our software portfolio to manage and secure IT infrastructures and environments could have a material adverse effect on our business.
The growth of our software business depends on demand for our data center virtualization portfolio, as well as customer acceptance of our software, services and business strategy.
Failure to enter into software license agreements on a satisfactory basis could materially adversely affect our business.
Our use of open source software in certain software and services could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, operating results and cash flow.
Our sales to government customers subject us to uncertainties and governmental regulations, which could have a material adverse effect on our business.
Failure to effectively manage our software solutions and services lifecycles could harm our business.
Competition in our industries could prevent us from growing our revenue.
Our operating results are subject to substantial quarterly and annual fluctuations.
paragraphs: Our business, operations and financial results are subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described below, that could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows and the trading price of our common stock. The following material factors, among others, could cause our actual results to differ materially from historical results and those expressed in forward-looking statements made by us or on our behalf in filings with the SEC, press releases, communications with investors and oral statements. Additional risks, trends and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are immaterial may also harm our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, our reputation or the trading price of our common stock.
The following is a summary of the material risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results.
•Adverse global economic conditions could have a negative effect on us.
•Our business is subject to various governmental regulations and trade restrictions.
•Global political and economic conditions and other factors related to our international operations could adversely affect us.
•We operate in a highly cyclical semiconductor industry that is undergoing profound change due to AI.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto, which appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion may contain forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under the caption "Risk Factors" or in other parts of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

The following section generally discusses our financial condition and results of operations for our fiscal year ended November 2, 2025 ("fiscal year 2025") compared to our fiscal year ended November 3, 2024 ("fiscal year 2024"). A discussion regarding our financial condition and results of operations for fiscal year 2024 compared to our fiscal year ended October 29, 2023 can be found in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on December 20, 2024.

We are a global technology leader that designs, develops and supplies a broad range of semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions and infrastructure software solutions. Our semiconductor and semiconductor-based solutions include a broad portfolio of complex digital and mixed signal devices based on silicon wafers with complementary metal oxide semiconductor transistors, III-V based devices, network interface cards and other modules, switches, subsystems and, in some cases, racks. Our solutions are used in a wide array of environments, end products and applications, such as enterprise and artificial intelligence ("AI") data centers, servers and networking and connectivity equipment, as well as storage systems, home connectivity devices, set-top boxes, broadband access, telecommunication equipment, wireless devices and base stations, factory automation, power generation and alternative energy systems, and electronic displays. Our infrastructure software solutions help enterprises simplify their information technology environments. Our customers rely on our infrastructure and security software solutions to modernize, optimize, and secure the most complex private cloud, hybrid cloud and edge environments. This enables scalability, agility, automation, insights, resiliency and security, making it easy for customers to run their mission-critical workloads. We also offer mission-critical fibre channel storage area networking ("FC SAN") products and related software in the form of modules, switches and subsystems incorporating multiple semiconductor products.

We have two reportable segments: semiconductor solutions and infrastructure software. Our semiconductor solutions segment includes all of our semiconductor-based product lines and intellectual property ("IP") licensing. Our infrastructure software segment includes our private cloud, mainframe software, cybersecurity and enterprise software portfolios, and our FC SAN business.

Our strategy is focused on sustained technology leadership and developing category-leading solutions to deliver a comprehensive suite of innovative infrastructure technology products to the world's leading business and government customers. We seek to achieve this through extensive internal research and development, as well as strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies, to ensure our products retain their technology market leadership. This strategy results in a robust business model designed to drive diversified and sustainable operating and financial results.
The demand for our solutions has been affected in the past, and is likely to continue to be affected in the future, by various factors, including the following:
•general economic and market conditions in the industries and markets in which we compete;
•anticipated or actual demand for AI-related products and solutions; •our distributors' product inventory and end-user demand;

•the rate at which our present and future customers and end-users adopt our solutions in our target markets, including our AI-related solutions, and the rate at which our customers' products that include our solutions are accepted in their markets;

•the shift to cloud-based information technology solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, which may adversely affect the timing and volume of sales of our solutions for use in traditional enterprise data centers; and
•the timing, rescheduling or cancellation of expected customer orders.
Highlights during fiscal year 2025 include the following:
•We generated $27,537 million of cash from operations.
•We paid $11,142 million in cash dividends.

paragraphs: 本公司為全球科技領導者，設計、開發並供應廣泛的半導體及半導體基準解決方案與基礎設施軟體解決方案。本公司超過60年的創新歷史可追溯至AT&T/Bell Labs、Lucent及Hewlett-Packard Company的多元起源，並透過收購持續演化，包括LSI Corporation、Broadcom Corporation、Brocade Communications Systems, Inc.、CA, Inc.、Symantec Enterprise Security及VMware, Inc.（"VMware"）。多年來，本公司已組建一支全球規模的半導體與軟體設計工程師團隊。本公司在美國、亞洲及歐洲等地維持設計、產品與軟體開發工程專業知識與資源。本公司結合全球規模、工程深度、廣泛產品組合、優越執行力與運營焦點，以提供領先業界的半導體與基礎設施軟體解決方案。
本公司策略聚焦於持續的科技領導地位，並開發領先業界的解決方案，以提供一套完整的創新基礎設施科技產品給全球的企業與政府客戶。本公司透過廣泛的內部研究與開發，以及戰略性的企業與技術收購，以確保產品維持其科技市場領導地位。此策略導致一個強固的商業模式，以驅動多元化且可持續的運營與財務成果。

本公司半導體及半導體基準解決方案包括基於硅晶圓的廣泛複雜數位與混合訊號裝置，包含補充金屬氧化物半導體（"CMOS"）電晶體、III-V基準裝置、網路介面卡（"NICs"）及其他模組、交換器、子系統，以及在某些情況下，機架。本公司解決方案應用於多種環境、終端產品與應用，例如企業與人工智慧（"AI"）資料中心、伺服器與網路與連線設備，以及儲存系統、家庭連線裝置、機上盒（"STB"）、寬頻存取、電信設備、無線裝置與基地臺、工廠自動化、發電與替代能源系統，以及電子顯示器。本公司透過高績效的設計與整合能力來區隔自己，並專注於開發半導體產品，以符合市場對本公司高品質、領先科技與整合性能半導體及半導體基準解決方案的需求。

本公司半導體及半導體基準解決方案也使客戶能夠建立並部署AI資料中心基礎設施，以執行其訓練與推理工作負載，並根據開放、靈活、基準標準的乙太網路管理其AI網路基礎設施中的資料移動。此外，本公司解決方案使客戶能在AI伺服器機架內及跨AI資料中心站點內與跨AI伺服器機架內進行大規模的加速計算與網路連線。這些解決方案的客戶包括超規模企業與擁有AI邊界模型的公司，以及原廠設備製造商（"OEMs"）與系統整合商，這些公司開發用於大型AI資料中心的伺服器、交換器與機架，以執行訓練與推理工作負載。本公司AI半導體解決方案包括客製化加速器或XPUs、乙太網路交換與路由晶片、乙太網路NICs、物理層裝置（"PHYs"）與光學元件，以及基於XPUs的機架與系統。
本公司提供半導體及半導體基準解決方案於五大主要終端市場：網路連線、無線裝置連線、伺服器與儲存系統、寬頻與工業。以下為本公司各終端市場與應用的關鍵解決方案描述。
網路連線。本公司解決方案管理資料中心、服務供應商與企業網路應用中的資料移動。本公司開發半導體產品，以實現加速計算與網路連線，部署於企業與AI資料中心及服務供應商的負載。本公司產品提供開放、靈活、基準標準的乙太網路NIC與交換解決方案，以解決資料中心中的連線瓶頸，特別是在AI資料中心，計算頻寬與叢集規模迅速增長的情況下。以下產品可用於AI與非AI負載與應用。

•客製化晶片解決方案：本公司為客戶提供先進技術與智慧財產權（"IP"）平台，以設計與開發用於AI與高性能計算、網路與儲存應用的應用特定積體電路（"ASICs"）。本公司客製化晶片解決方案提供整合嵌入式邏輯、高頻寬記憶體、序列化/反序列化技術、IP核心與處理器核心的平台，使用先進封裝技術。ASICs為根據本公司個別客戶的規格所製造的客製化產品，例如本公司客製化加速器或XPUs，供超規模企業、擁有AI邊界模型的公司與系統整合商使用，有時也用於機架或系統。

•乙太網路交換與路由：乙太網路是一種普遍的連接技術，可實現高性能且成本效益的網路基礎設施。本公司提供一套廣泛的乙太網路交換與路由產品，優化於企業與AI資料中心、服務供應商與企業網路。對於超規模企業及其他擁有AI邊界模型的客戶，本公司高容量、低延遲的交換晶片支援資料中心的先進協議，如虛擬化與多路徑。本公司乙太網路交換晶片技術提供建立高度可擴展的扁平網路的能力，支援數萬臺伺服器。本公司服務供應商交換產品組合使電信業者能夠支援其網路中無線回傳、存取、聚合與核心的資料流量優先傳輸。對於企業網路，本公司提供具備安全加密交換功能的產品系列，並支援符合產業標準的低功耗模式，以符合能源效率乙太網路的標準。
•Ethernet NIC Controllers: 我們的 Ethernet NIC 控制器是用於高效能虛擬化、智慧流量處理、安全資料中心連線以及機器學習。

•Physical Layer Devices: 這些裝置為轉接器，可用於透過銅線或光纖等實體媒介接收與傳送 Ethernet 數據封包。我們的高性能 Ethernet 轉接器是基於專有數位訊號處理 (DSP) 通訊架構所設計，優化於高速網路連線，並支援最新標準與先進功能，例如節能 Ethernet、資料加密與時間同步。我們也提供一系列汽車 Ethernet 產品，包括 PHYs、交換器與相機微控制器，用於車內連線與智慧視覺。
•Fiber Optic Components: 我們提供廣泛的光學元件，用於 Ethernet 網路、儲存、以及接入、城域與長距電信市場。我們的光學元件可用於透過光纖進行高速數據接收與傳送。
Wireless Device Connectivity Solutions. 我們提供無線裝置市場的領先連線解決方案。我們的產品包括射頻 ("RF") 前端模組與濾波器、Wi-Fi/Bluetooth 組合晶片、客製化觸控控制器與感應充電裝置。

•RF Semiconductor Devices: 我們的裝置會選擇性地過濾，以及放大與路由射頻訊號。濾波器讓現代無線通訊系統能同時支援大量用戶，確保多個語音與數據流的傳送與接收不會互相干擾。我們的 RF 裝置包括多晶片前端模組，整合傳送/接收切換與過濾功能，支援多個頻率帶，濾波器模組與離散濾波器，皆使用我們專有的商業薄膜體聲共振 ("FBAR") 濾波器技術。我們在 FBAR 技術、放大器設計與模組整合方面的專業知識，使我們能在行動 RF 收發器應用中提供業界領先的性能。
•Connectivity Solutions: 我們的解決方案是為無線裝置，包括智慧型手機、平板電腦與穿戴式產品所設計。我們提供一系列高性能、低功耗的 Wi-Fi 晶片組，以及 Bluetooth 硅晶與軟體產品。這些解決方案包括組合晶片，提供整合 Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth 功能，相較於離散解決方案，具有顯著的性能優勢。

paragraphs: 本項管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析應配合本公司合併財務報表及其附註，該等財務報表載於本年度10-K表報中其他處。本項討論可能包含基於目前預期之展望性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。本公司實際結果可能與這些展望性陳述所預期者有重大差異，原因可能為多種因素，包括於"風險因素"標題下所述或本年度10-K表報其他部分所列之因素。
以下部分一般討論本公司財政年度終結於2025年11月2日（"財政年2025"）之財務狀況與營運成果，與財政年度終結於2024年11月3日（"財政年2024"）相比。有關財政年2024之財務狀況與營運成果與財政年度終結於2023年10月29日之比較，可參閱本公司2024年度10-K表報之第二部分，第7項，該表報已於2024年12月20日提交至證券交易委員會（"SEC"）。

本公司為全球科技領導者，設計、開發並供應廣泛之半導體及半導體基準解決方案與基礎建設軟體解決方案。本公司之半導體及半導體基準解決方案包括基於矽晶圓之廣泛複雜數位與混合訊號裝置，包含補充金屬氧化物半導體電晶體（CMOS）、III-V基準裝置、網路介面卡及其他模組、交換器、子系統，以及在某些情況下包含機架。本公司解決方案應用於廣泛之環境、終端產品與應用，例如企業與人工智慧（"AI"）資料中心、伺服器與網路與連線設備，以及儲存系統、家庭連線裝置、機上盒、寬頻存取、電信設備、無線裝置與基地臺、工廠自動化、電力發電與替代能源系統，以及電子顯示器。本公司基礎建設軟體解決方案協助企業簡化其資訊科技環境。本公司客戶依賴本公司基礎建設與安全軟體解決方案，以現代化、最佳化並保護最複雜之私有雲端、混合雲端與邊緣環境。此可實現擴展性、靈活性、自動化、洞察力、韌性與安全性，使客戶輕鬆執行其關鍵業務工作負載。本公司亦提供關鍵業務之光纖通道儲存區域網路（"FC SAN"）產品與相關軟體，以模組、交換器與子系統形式提供，這些產品整合多種半導體產品。
本公司有兩個應報告分部：半導體解決方案與基礎建設軟體。本公司半導體解決方案分部包含所有半導體基準產品線與智慧財產權（"IP"）授權。本公司基礎建設軟體分部包含本公司私有雲端、大型主機軟體、網路安全與企業軟體產品組合，以及本公司FC SAN業務。
本公司策略聚焦於維持科技領導地位，並開發具類別領導優勢的解決方案，以提供一套完整的創新基礎設施科技產品，服務全球領先的企業與政府客戶。本公司透過廣泛的內部研究與開發，以及戰略性的企業與科技收購，以確保產品持續保持科技市場領導地位。此策略造就了一個強固的商業模式，用以驅動多元化且可持續的營運與財務成果。
過去我們的解決方案需求曾受到多種因素影響，未來亦可能持續受到影響，包括以下因素：
•我們所從事產業與市場的總體經濟與市場狀況；
•預期或實際的與人工智慧相關產品與解決方案需求；•我們經銷商的產品存貨與最終用戶需求；
•本公司現有及未來客戶與終端用戶在目標市場採用本公司解決方案的速度，包括與人工智慧相關的解決方案，以及客戶產品中包含本公司解決方案在他們市場被接受的速度；
•向雲端基礎資訊科技解決方案與服務轉移，例如超規模計算，這可能會不利於本公司解決方案在傳統企業資料中心使用的銷售時程與銷售量；
•預期客戶訂單的時程、重新排程或取消；
•財務年度2025年的亮點包括以下內容：
•我們自營運產生 27,537 百萬美元現金。
•我們以現金支付 11,142 百萬美元股息。

惡化之全球經濟情勢可能對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況與流動性產生負面影響。
本公司國際業務所涉及之全球政治與經濟情勢及其他因素，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況與營運結果產生負面影響。
本公司營運於高度週期性之半導體產業，該產業正因人工智慧而經歷深刻變革。
來自特定客戶的訂單大幅減少或失去一個或多個重要客戶，可能會對本公司業務造成不利影響。
若無法調整製造與供應鏈以符合客戶需求，可能會對本公司營運成果造成不利影響。
本公司購買用於產品的大量材料，包括零組件，皆來自有限數量的供應商。
本公司業務若失去現有高階管理團隊成員，將會造成不利影響。
本公司毛利率取決於多項因素，包括產品組成、新商業模式的採用、價格下滑、產能利用率及原物料價格。
若無法吸引並留住合格人才，尤其是工程與技術人員，本公司可能無法有效執行業務策略。
本公司或客戶、供應商的設施或其他重要業務若發生長期中斷，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
本公司面臨與經銷商及其他通路夥伴相關的風險，包括產品存貨水準及產品銷售情況。
本公司軟體產品組合若無法管理及確保資訊科技基礎建設與環境，可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司軟體業務的成長取決於對資料中心虛擬化產品組合的需求，以及客戶對本公司軟體、服務與商業策略的接受度。
若無法以滿意的條件簽訂軟體授權協議，可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司在某些軟體與服務中使用開放原始碼軟體，可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流造成重大不利影響。
本公司對政府客戶的銷售使本公司面臨不確定性與政府規範，這可能對本公司業務造成重大不利影響。
若無法有效管理軟體解決方案與服務的生命週期，可能損害本公司業務。
本公司所處產業的競爭可能阻礙本公司成長營收。
本公司營運成果會受到相當程度的季節性與年度波動影響。
paragraphs: 本公司之業務、營運及財務表現受多種風險與不確定性影響，包括下列所列風險，這些風險可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及普通股之交易價格產生不利影響。下列重要因素，及其他因素，可能使本公司之實際結果與歷史結果及本公司或代表本公司在向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交之申報文件、新聞稿、與投資者溝通及口頭陳述中所發表之預測性陳述有重大差異。此外，尚有其他未為本公司所知或目前認為不重要之風險、趨勢與不確定性，也可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流、聲譽或普通股之交易價格造成損害。
下列為可能對本公司之業務、營運及財務結果產生不利影響之重要風險摘要。
• 不利之全球經濟情勢可能對本公司產生負面影響。
• 本公司之業務受多種政府法規及貿易限制之影響。
• 全球政治與經濟情勢及其他與本公司國際營運相關之因素可能對本公司產生不利影響。
• 本公司營運於高度週期性之半導體產業，該產業正因人工智慧（AI）而經歷深刻變革。
